meta.scope: Philippines Batch 8 — continued densification: digital economy satellite account, external debt, governance/integrity framing, additional financial and structural nodes.

candidates.title: Philippine Digital Economy Satellite Account (PDESA)
candidates.description: Official satellite account measuring the size and contribution of the digital economy (digital infrastructure, e-commerce, digital content/media, government digital services). Recent figures put digital GVA around 9–10 % of GDP and employment in the tens of millions.
candidates.notes: High-value digital-economy measurement node. Complements the IT-BPM industry statistics.

candidates.title: E-commerce component of the digital economy
candidates.description: E-commerce share of digital-economy output and especially employment (largest employment component in recent PDESA releases).

candidates.title: External debt statistics
candidates.description: Outstanding external debt (public and private), by creditor type and maturity. Complements the national-government debt series and the BOP/IIP.
candidates.notes: External-debt densification of the external-sector cluster.

candidates.title: Governance and anti-corruption policy framing
candidates.publisher: Government of the Philippines / related oversight bodies
candidates.description: Recurring policy and public-debate framing around corruption, accountability and governance quality. Continuously referenced in fiscal, infrastructure and investment discussions (including high-profile flood-control and public-works issues).
candidates.notes: Governance-frame node. Complements the statistical fiscal and disaster clusters.

candidates.title: Oversight institutions (Ombudsman, Commission on Audit) institutional role
candidates.publisher: Office of the Ombudsman / Commission on Audit
candidates.description: Constitutional and statutory oversight bodies responsible for accountability, audit and anti-graft functions. Continuously cited in governance and public-finance integrity analysis.

candidates.title: Monetary aggregates and banking statistics
candidates.description: Money supply, credit and related banking indicators that complement the financial-system resources series and feed monetary-policy analysis.
candidates.notes: Monetary densification of the central-bank cluster.

candidates.title: International Investment Position
candidates.description: Stock measure of external financial assets and liabilities. Complements the flow BOP and the external-debt series.

candidates.title: Philippines digital–external-debt–governance densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from PSA, BSP and governance sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding the Digital Economy Satellite Account, e-commerce component, external debt, International Investment Position, monetary aggregates, governance/anti-corruption framing and oversight institutions into a denser digital–external–governance layer.
